title: Typed DVCMin model
description: Restates QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload; DVCMin logical model (trust-phw). QR Code Generation, 3. Step 2 — Assemble the payload: “The DVC payload uses short element names because every byte is paid for twice”.

statements.label: Typed DVCMin model
statements.requirement: The library SHALL provide a typed DVCMin payload with the short element names and cardinalities of the logical model: n 1..1, dob 1..1, s 1..1, nt 1..1, id 0..1, dt 0..1, gn 0..1, vx 1..1, v 1..1, and a PayloadCodec for it.

successCriteria.criterion: A test named after STT-PAY-001 passes in each implementation's suite (Kotlin: `STT-PAY-001 STT-PAY-002 STT-PAY-005 a newborn's DVCMin, with no identity document, round-trips as typed fields` (AssemblePayloadTest.kt); `STT-TST-001 STT-PAY-001 both PR 129 certificates verify and decode as published` (ConformanceVectorsTest.kt)).
